nodes.name: Weekly Cron Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires every week. Triggers the full benchmark scrape pipeline.

nodes.name: Load Seed Hub URLs
nodes.notes: Emits one item per verified hub URL. Source of truth: scraper/seed_urls.py

nodes.name: Split In Batches
nodes.notes: Process one hub URL at a time for per-source error isolation.

parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/125.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

nodes.name: HTTP Request - Fetch Hub Page
nodes.notes: Fetches hub page HTML. timeout=10s, follows redirects. Error output routes to failure logger.

nodes.name: Status 200 Gate
nodes.notes: Only proceeds to HTML extraction on HTTP 200. Non-200 routes to failure logger.

nodes.name: HTML Extract - Find PDF Links
nodes.notes: CSS selector: a[href$='.pdf'] extracts all anchor tags whose href ends in .pdf. Returns array of PDF URLs.

nodes.name: Normalize PDF URLs
nodes.notes: Deduplicates links, resolves relative paths to absolute URLs. Emits one item per PDF URL.

nodes.name: POST to Scraper Microservice
nodes.notes: POSTs PDF URL to Python scraper microservice (localhost:8001/scrape). Microservice handles robots.txt, PDF parsing, and benchmark_products DB writes. n8n orchestrates; Python does heavy parsing.

nodes.name: Notify Backend - Scrape Complete
nodes.notes: POST /webhooks/n8n/scrape-complete — backend invalidates stale compare-page caches. Per docs/n8n.md step 5.

nodes.name: Log Failure to Backend
nodes.notes: Logs per-source failures to backend scrape_jobs table. Does NOT abort the whole batch.

nodes.name: Check Failure Threshold
nodes.notes: Triggers alert if >= 3 sources fail. Per spec: 'if failures exceed a threshold, send a Slack/email alert'.

meta.notes: Workflow created 2026-09-18. Matches spec in docs/n8n.md (scrape-benchmarks). Pipeline: Weekly Cron -> Load Seed Hub URLs -> Split In Batches -> HTTP Request (fetch hub) -> Status 200 Gate -> HTML Extract (find PDFs) -> Normalize PDF URLs -> Filter Valid -> POST to Scraper Microservice -> Notify Backend. Failures: Log -> Check Threshold -> Slack Alert. See scraper/seed_urls.py for verified URL list.
